routine: C0/9AA1, C0/9AC8, C0/9AD3 (+ common tail C0/9AB2) — field tile-property fetch + off-map solid early-out
summary: This cluster reads the three de-interleaved tile-property "planes" for one map cell. The cell INDEX is `(16-bit tentative position word) AND $1D1E/$1D1F` (the precomputed cell mask), used as X into four parallel 0x40-byte-per-row WRAM planes. 9AA1 and 9AC8 are identical except 9AA1 first checks the off-map sentinel plane $7E70C0,X via BMI: if bit7 is CLEAR it returns immediately with CARRY SET (= off-map, treat as SOLID) without touching the output bytes; if bit7 is SET it falls through to load the bytes. 9AC8 skips that check and always falls through to the common tail at 9AB2. The common tail 9AB2 stores byte0=$7E30C0,X→$1D58, byte1=$7E7000,X→$1D5A, byte2=$7E7040,X→$1D5C, then returns CARRY CLEAR (in-bounds). 9AD3 is a separate routine (the shape-decode prologue, not a fetch): it zeroes the collision-result scratch ($1D5E,$1D60,$1D6A,$1D6C,$1D6E) and starts shape decode by computing $1D56=$1D68>>2; it is always called right after a fetch.
dp: $1D00 (D=$1D00 in all callers: player body sets it at C0/881E; the conveyor/plane re-entry C0/9DDE sets `LDA #$1D00; TCD` at 9DE1). So dp operand $XX = WRAM $7E:1DXX.
wramReads: $7E70C0,X (8-bit) @9AAA — off-map SENTINEL plane; bit7 CLEAR => off-map => carry SET (SOLID); bit7 SET => valid cell, load bytes
$7E30C0,X (8-bit) @9AB2 — tile property BYTE0 plane (collision shape = (byte0&0xFC)>>2; bit0/bit1 = actor-blocking flags)
$7E7000,X (8-bit) @9AB8 — tile property BYTE1 plane (byte1&0x10 = DOOR; conveyor source at apply C0/9C5C)
$7E7040,X (8-bit) @9ABE — tile property BYTE2 plane (byte2&3 = z-plane; &4 IGNORE_Z; &8 INVERTED; &0x20 Z_NEUTRAL; &0x40 SPRITE_FRONT_BOTTOM)
$1D1E/$1D1F (16-bit) @9AA5/9ACC — CELL MASK; (pos_word AND mask) = linear byte index into the 0x40-stride planes. Precomputed at scene/map load (outside this cluster, not under DP=$1D00).
$1D68 (8-bit) @9ADD — Y-position high byte of tentative position; >>2 -> $1D56 sub-tile Y (9AD3 head)

A on entry — 16-bit cell-source position word. Callers 8AA4/9C8D build it (LDA $68 16-bit then SEP; LDA $67 8-bit) => A = ($1D69<<8)|$1D67; caller 9DEA uses $0102/$0103 (location/scroll anchor) instead.
entryPoints: C0/9AA1 -> prop_fetch CHECKED: AND mask, TAX, check $7E70C0 sentinel; bit7 clear => carry SET (SOLID); else load 3 bytes + carry CLEAR
C0/9AB2 -> common TAIL: load byte0/1/2 into $1D58/$1D5A/$1D5C, SEP #$10, carry CLEAR
C0/9AC8 -> prop_fetch UNCHECKED: AND mask, TAX, BRA tail (no sentinel check, always carry CLEAR)
C0/9AD3 -> collision-result init + shape-decode head (clears $5E/$60/$6A/$6C/$6E, sets $56=$68>>2); NOT a property fetch
callsOut: none — no JSR/JSL/BRL leaves this cluster; 9AA1/9AC8 RTS, 9AD3 falls through into the in-bank shape decoder at 9AE3 (same routine body)
romTables: No ROM tables read by 9AA1/9AC8/9AB2/9AD3 themselves. The shape decoder that 9AD3 flows into reads slope tables (outside this cluster) starting ~9AF9/9B08: C0/9BF5 = 82 02 02 82 81 01 01 81 83 03 03 83 81 01 01 81 83 03 03 83 82 02 ; C0/9C0B = 3D 03 03 3D 7D 03 C3 3D 3E 23 03 1D 3D C3 03 7D 1E 03 23 3D 3D 03 ; C0/9C21 = 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00
uncertainties: SENTINEL POLARITY (CRITICAL): 9AAE opcode is `30 02` = BMI $9AB2, branching when N(bit7) is SET to the byte-loading tail (carry CLEAR = in-bounds). So $7E70C0[i] bit7==1 means VALID cell; bit7==0 means OFF-MAP => SEC at 9AB0 => carry SET => SOLID. This is the OPPOSITE of the CLAUDE.md hint ('bit7 early-out = off-map SOLID, carry set'). Carry is only set on the bit7-CLEAR fall-through. Verifier must confirm live $7E70C0 plane content to pin which value flags off-map. (Read directly from the opcode.)

A.high on entry: callers do `LDA $68` (16-bit -> A=$1D68|$1D69) then `SEP #$20; LDA $67` (8-bit, overwrites only A.low). So A.high = $1D69, A.low = $1D67, giving cell-source word = ($1D69<<8)|$1D67. The 9DEA path: `LDA $0102` (16-bit) then SEP => A.high=$0103, A.low=$0102. Earlier note said high=$1D68/$1D66; re-verify exact byte indices ($1D67/$1D69 vs $1D66/$1D68) against the mask layout.

CELL MASK $1D1E/$1D1F construction is upstream (scene/map load, different DP) and was not found in bank C0 under DP=$1D00; treated as opaque input. Confirm its bit pattern (expected: low byte masked to tile_x within 0x3F, high byte to tile_y row stride of 0x40) so that (pos AND mask) == tile_y*0x40 + tile_x. This is the key unknown for matching the Python tile-index model (ty*cw+tx) to the ROM's fixed 0x40 stride.

9AD3 is grouped here per the focus list but is functionally the shape-decoder prologue, not a fetch. It is always invoked immediately after a fetch (8AAC, 9C90, 9DF5) and reads the just-fetched $1D58 and $1D68. Port it as part of the shape-decode routine (9AD3-9BF4) rather than the fetch.

X width: REP #$10 at 9AA1/9AC8 makes X 16-bit for the plane indexing; SEP #$10 at 9AC4 restores 8-bit X before RTS. The $7E:30C0/7000/7040/70C0 loads are long (absolute WRAM) so indexing is independent of DP. Confirmed from opcodes.
